New Asphalt Shingle Roof Installation in Santa Clara, CA
Roof Express recently completed another new asphalt shingle roof installation in Santa Clara, California, giving this home a durable, attractive, and professionally installed roofing system designed for long-term protection.

Replacing an aging roof is one of the most important investments a homeowner can make. A properly installed asphalt shingle roof not only protects the property from rain, wind, sun exposure, and moisture intrusion but can also dramatically improve the home's curb appeal and overall value.
Professional Roof Replacement in Santa Clara
For this Santa Clara roofing project, our team carefully removed the existing roofing materials and prepared the roof for the installation of the new asphalt shingle roofing system.

Proper preparation is one of the most important parts of any roof replacement in Santa Clara. Before installing the new roofing materials, our crew inspected the roof deck and critical areas of the roofing system to identify any conditions requiring attention.

The new roofing system was then installed following professional roofing practices, applicable building requirements, and manufacturer installation specifications.
Why Asphalt Shingles Are a Great Choice for Santa Clara Homes
Asphalt shingles remain one of the most popular roofing materials for residential properties throughout Santa Clara and the greater San Francisco Bay Area.

Modern architectural asphalt shingles provide an excellent combination of:

Long-term durability

Attractive architectural appearance

Weather protection

Multiple color and design choices

Cost-effective roof replacement

Improved curb appeal

Manufacturer warranty options

Relatively easy maintenance

Dimensional asphalt shingles use multiple layers to create a thicker and more distinctive appearance than traditional strip shingles. Premium products can also provide enhanced performance and warranty options.
A Complete Roofing System — Not Just New Shingles
A quality roof replacement involves much more than simply installing shingles.

At Roof Express, we focus on the complete roofing system. Depending on the individual property and project specifications, a residential roof replacement may include removal of existing roofing materials, roof deck inspection, replacement of damaged plywood, synthetic underlayment, waterproofing protection at vulnerable areas, new flashing, starter shingles, field shingles, hip and ridge shingles, ventilation improvements, and other necessary roofing components.

Every roof is different, which is why we evaluate each property individually before recommending the appropriate roofing system.
Protecting Vulnerable Areas of the Roof
Waterproofing is particularly important around areas where water is more likely to enter the roofing system.

These areas can include roof valleys, eaves, plumbing penetrations, vents, skylights, chimneys, roof-to-wall transitions, and other penetrations.

Proper flashing and waterproofing help reduce the possibility of future leaks and moisture-related damage.
Roof Ventilation Matters
A roofing system also needs appropriate ventilation.

When evaluating a Santa Clara roof replacement, our team can inspect the existing ventilation configuration and determine whether improvements should be considered as part of the project.

Proper attic and roof ventilation can help manage heat and moisture accumulation and contribute to the overall performance of the roofing system.
Quality Asphalt Shingle Options
Roof Express installs high-quality asphalt shingle roofing systems from leading manufacturers, including CertainTeed.

CertainTeed's Landmark family, for example, offers dimensional asphalt shingles designed to provide the appearance of wood shake while offering the practical benefits of asphalt roofing. CertainTeed also offers upgraded products such as Landmark PRO and other premium roofing options.

Depending on the specific product selected, homeowners can choose from numerous colors, profiles, performance levels, and warranty options.
Improving the Home's Curb Appeal
One of the most noticeable differences after a roof replacement is the transformation in appearance.

Because the roof represents such a large portion of a home's exterior, installing new architectural shingles can completely refresh the property.

Choosing the right shingle color can complement the home's siding, stucco, trim, gutters, windows, and surrounding architectural features.

For this Santa Clara asphalt shingle roof installation, the completed roofing system provides both improved protection and a clean, updated appearance.
Roofing Contractor Serving Santa Clara, CA
Roof Express provides professional residential and commercial roofing services throughout Santa Clara and the San Francisco Bay Area.

Our roofing services include:

Asphalt shingle roof replacement

New roof installation

Flat roofing systems

Modified bitumen roofing

Roof inspections

Roof repairs

Emergency leak repair

Plywood and roof deck replacement

Skylight installation and replacement

Gutter and downspout installation

Roof ventilation

Waterproofing and flashing

Roofing maintenance

Whether your roof has reached the end of its service life or you are experiencing leaks, damaged shingles, deteriorated flashing, or other roofing problems, our team can inspect the property and recommend an appropriate solution.
Looking for a Roofing Contractor in Santa Clara?

We provide professional roof inspections and detailed roofing estimates for homeowners and property owners throughout Santa Clara and surrounding Bay Area communities.

From the initial roof inspection through installation and final cleanup, our goal is to provide a professional roofing experience and a roofing system built for long-term performance.

Frequently Asked Questions About Roof Replacement in Santa ClaraHow do I know if I need a new roof?
Common signs include missing or damaged shingles, recurring roof leaks, deteriorated flashing, visible roof wear, damaged decking, and a roofing system approaching the end of its expected service life. A professional inspection can help determine whether repairs or complete replacement are appropriate.
How long does an asphalt shingle roof installation take?
The installation timeline depends on roof size, complexity, existing roofing conditions, required deck repairs, weather, permitting, and other project-specific factors. Many residential roofing projects can be completed relatively quickly once work begins.
What asphalt shingles are available?
Roof Express can provide different architectural and premium asphalt shingle options depending on the homeowner's preferred appearance, performance requirements, budget, and applicable project requirements.
Do you provide roofing estimates in Santa Clara?
Yes. Roof Express provides roofing inspections and estimates for residential and commercial properties in Santa Clara and throughout our Bay Area service territory.
